disposition: A pass authorizes freezing a separate multi-rollout-per-paper training protocol. A support fail stops Stage D live training without threshold changes. An outcome-independent infrastructure failure follows the bounded defect-class policy and is not silently relabeled as science.

failure_dispositions.bounded_redeployment: At most one redeployment is allowed for a demonstrated outcome-independent infrastructure failure before any model response bytes are observed. It must preserve every scientific and sampling field and be recorded in a hardware-only or infrastructure-only amendment.
failure_dispositions.future_successors: A terminal support result does not prohibit all future engineering work. Any future live successor requires explicit user authorization, a distinct preregistration, fresh observed addresses, an outcome-independent diagnosis, and a full-stack regression matching the defect before model calls.
failure_dispositions.ordinary_negative_support: Any well-formed observed topology outside eligibility, including child continuation or later-root child spawning, is durably finalized as denominator-negative with all commitments excluded from replay. It is not retried.
failure_dispositions.terminal_invariant: Malformed causal provenance, duplicate structural addresses, request-response mismatch, transport ambiguity after a request, ledger inconsistency, or any rerun of an address with observed bytes terminates this support campaign.

forward_plan.capacity_unavailable: Make no mutation, spend nothing, and resume the same frozen campaign when qualifying capacity is available.
forward_plan.pre_response_infrastructure_failure: Recover diagnostics, terminate compute, classify against the frozen defect matrix, and use the single bounded redeployment only when the failure is demonstrably outcome-independent.
forward_plan.support_fail: Recover and verify all support evidence, terminate compute, publish the denominator result, and do not start scientific training or alter the support thresholds.
forward_plan.support_pass: Recover and verify all support evidence, terminate compute, use measured eligible-target and token costs to freeze a separately reviewed scientific power and budget plan, and require a fresh explicit launch authorization before scientific model calls.
forward_plan.terminal_invariant: Recover whatever evidence is unambiguous, terminate compute, record the invariant failure, retire every address with observed response bytes, and do not redeploy this campaign.

runtime_assertions: capture ceiling 16 is distinct from harness max policy turns 8
one mandatory full-stack regression drives root and child returns through TrainClient, renderer, interception, source finalization, roster freeze, and replay exclusion
child continuation and later-root child topologies durably finalize as ineligible with excluded commitments
compaction does not change the causal root policy-event parent binding
all configured tests execute with zero skips after patches are applied before imports

purpose: Measure whether the frozen scaffold policy yields enough exact replay targets on 64 unique support papers to justify a separate scientific campaign while retaining well-formed natural topology as auditable denominator evidence.
repair_rule: V9 is a user-authorized successor to v8's overbroad hard stop. Never rerun an address with observed bytes. Preserve model, adapter, prompt, sampling, support thresholds, and scientific rules. Classify failures by frozen defect class: well-formed unsupported topology is an ordinary denominator-negative outcome; malformed or ambiguous evidence is terminal; only a pre-response outcome-independent infrastructure defect permits one recorded redeployment.

user_authorization.statement: Approval granted to supersede the v8 no-v9 stop and continue under a more future-planning bounded-repair policy.
